> **This is a private channel for legal notices, not a public issue
> tracker.** Filing here opens a private thread that only the
> maintainer can see. Do not file routine bug reports or feature
> requests through this template.

> **If you are a security researcher**, please use the
> [GitHub Security Advisory](../../security/advisories/new) channel
> instead. This template is for legal notices.

### Your identity and capacity

- Your name:
- Your organisation (if any):
- Your role (in-house counsel, outside counsel, individual rights
  holder, law-enforcement officer, etc.):

### Nature of the notice

Select the type that best describes your notice:

- [ ] DMCA takedown
- [ ] Cease-and-desist / demand letter
- [ ] Trademark complaint
- [ ] Patent infringement allegation
- [ ] Privacy / data-protection complaint
- [ ] Law-enforcement request
- [ ] Court order / subpoena
- [ ] Other (describe)

### Subject of the notice

What is the notice about? Please quote the relevant text, and (if
applicable) identify the file, commit, or behaviour that is at issue.

### Specific request

What do you want the maintainer to do?

### Evidence

Attach any documents or exhibits you wish the maintainer to review.
If the file is sensitive, please indicate whether you would like the
maintainer to sign an NDA before reviewing.

### Confidentiality

Are you willing to have the substance of the notice (but not your
identity) summarised in a public `LEGAL_NOTES.md` for transparency?
This is the maintainer's preferred default.

### Contact

How should the maintainer respond to you? (GitHub private message,
email, postal mail, etc.)
